help.title: Love beer but hate working out?
help.intro: Here's a simple trick to get yourself moving: earn your beer by doing push-ups 💪🏼➡️🍺
help.text_setup: Open Settings > Exchange rate. Enter how much one beer usually costs and how many push-ups you will do for one beer. You're all set!
help.text_1: When you have a moment, do a few push-ups or squats, whatever works. Even 3 or 5 will do.
help.text_2: On the main screen, enter the number of exercises and tap *Add*. Your Beer Credit will grow accordingly.
help.text_3: When you buy a beer, tap *Beer time!* and write off the money you spent.
help.text_4: Be honest: Not enough credit? Skip that beer! Next time, move your butt and do more push-ups beforehand!
help.final: This is not a proper workout of course. But still better than nothing. The method has been scientifically validated and approved by the Alaska Academy of Giraffe Grooming and the Non-Licenced Amateur Divers Society of Sewerville.*
help.footnote: *That was a joke, just in case.
